claims.claim: Image-based human modeling and tracking precedents predate the 1990s; modern textured reconstruction is not identical to those predecessor tasks.
Parametric models, explicit surfaces, neural implicit fields and Gaussian representations coexist and are combined.
Relightable human-avatar and performance-capture research continues in 2026, independently of robot-transfer work.
Human interaction reconstruction is already connected to retargeting and robot policy data in current papers; that connection alone is not a sufficient novelty claim.
Hand2Robot Section 3 specifies RGB-D videos with camera intrinsics, not an RGB-only input setting.
HOI-Retarget Section V-A states source motion/contact errors propagate, and its palm-contact representation does not model finger closure, contact distribution or grasp forces.
The official FunREC page labels the work CVPR 2026 and shows code/data as soon at the checked date.
The official HumanTracker repository labels the work ECCV 2026; it evaluates tracking from mocap-derived robot references and diagnoses contact/stability issues.
Representative papers alone cannot establish field-wide decline, a boom ending, or an inevitable migration to robotics.
Counts through 2026-10-20 must not be interpreted as a full 2026 year and compared naively with full prior years.

research_directions.title: Generalizable metric human–scene reconstruction
research_directions.hypothesis_not_established_result: Joint human/scene geometry with uncertain scale priors may reduce world-space drift.
research_directions.minimal_test: Frozen pretrained backbone plus joint refinement on controlled calibrated clips; evaluate absolute scale, relative geometry and trajectory.
research_directions.novelty_and_validity_risk: Body priors can bias scale and shape; pointmap plus HMR is already close to existing work.

research_directions.title: Observation-faithful controllable 4D avatars
research_directions.hypothesis_not_established_result: Separating observed reconstruction from generative completion may preserve fidelity while supporting new pose/view/light.
research_directions.minimal_test: Evaluate observed/unobserved regions and separately held-out view, pose and lighting on scan/video references.
research_directions.novelty_and_validity_risk: Photorealism can conceal geometry errors; comparisons must respect lightstage, input and identity conditions.

research_directions.title: Joint human–object–scene interaction reconstruction
research_directions.hypothesis_not_established_result: Contact-local geometric and temporal evidence may improve interaction consistency beyond global surface losses.
research_directions.minimal_test: Known rigid objects first; independent fitting versus contact and uncertainty-aware joint fitting.
research_directions.novelty_and_validity_risk: Contact losses already exist; force, mass and friction are not uniquely identified from appearance.

research_directions.title: Uncertainty and selective reconstruction
research_directions.hypothesis_not_established_result: Calibrated uncertainty may predict sequence/contact failure and guide view selection or deferral.
research_directions.minimal_test: Controlled view subsets, occlusion and corruption; risk–coverage and failure detection at fixed budgets.
research_directions.novelty_and_validity_risk: Confidence is not a calibrated probability and may fail under distribution shifts.

research_directions.title: Capture quality and reproducible evaluation
research_directions.hypothesis_not_established_result: Controlled calibration and synchronization error studies can reveal when geometry metrics fail to predict application utility.
research_directions.minimal_test: Hold clips fixed while varying timing, scale, extrinsics and camera count; report sequence-level confidence intervals.
research_directions.novelty_and_validity_risk: Pseudo-ground-truth circularity, data leakage, consent and incompatible licenses.

research_directions.title: Robotics as one downstream branch
research_directions.hypothesis_not_established_result: Object-relative contact and uncertainty may improve cross-embodiment use of reconstructed human demonstrations.
research_directions.minimal_test: Fix controller and robot-data budget; compare geometry-only, contact-aware and confidence-aware inputs in a few tasks.
research_directions.novelty_and_validity_risk: Existing direct reconstruction-to-robot pipelines; simulation plausibility does not establish hardware safety or broad transfer.
